premises.text: Fans feel disconnected from the stadium experience while watching games remotely
premises.evidence_span: he realized, just like millions of others around the world, he was disconnected from the stadium

premises.text: VibeCast enables fans to transmit their energy into the stadium
premises.evidence_span: VibeCast now enables fans using connected devices to transmit their energy straight into the stadium

premises.text: A Vibe board visually represents fan energy contributions
premises.evidence_span: A Vibe board is a graphical representation of fan energy

premises.text: Fans can interact with the Vibe board through a mobile application
premises.evidence_span: I can contribute to it using, for example, a VibeCast application in a smartphone

premises.text: VibeCast captures and compares fan noise levels from around the world
premises.evidence_span: you can see which team has the loudest fans

premises.text: VibeCast provides unique data for CRM activities and brand integration
premises.evidence_span: we capture a unique set of data that can feed into your CRM activities

premises.text: Connected merchandise can enhance fan engagement
premises.evidence_span: we have developed a fan chip that can, for $4, just plug into any merchandise you have, making it connected

value.text: Fans can feel more connected to the game and each other through VibeCast
value.evidence_span: it's time to make the world a stadium for your fans

notes: Traction details and specific partnerships excluded as they do not represent premises.
